components.text:
Circle: medium circle, infernal chalk.

Only with Ascension. A witch-type performer opens the road to Great Mage for the one on the circle, or for herself, on a full-moon night.

The one on the circle must agree by sneaking. The addon's own switch for the skill still decides whether the road is open.

Costs rare items, altar power and 200,000 of their base Max EP, spent once the skill is learned.
Needs a full moon: the moon must be full, between dusk and dawn, in the Overworld. An eclipse counts too. The hub's moon calendar shows when the next one rises.
